title: Settings of the file destination
description: The settings of the file destination (T-04.3, section 7.2 of PR-001): events appended as JSON Lines to a file, with rotation by size and a quota on the total space. The library never picks a path: the directory comes from the consumer, who passes the values in (ADR-004). Files: the current file and, when it rotates, file_name.1 (the newest) ... file_name.(max_files - 1) (the oldest). When the total passes the quota the oldest rotated files are deleted first; the current file is never deleted. The order of the properties is the order in which a validation reports its problems.

directory.description: The directory of the files. Required: the library picks no path. It is created (owner only) if it does not exist and must be writable, which is checked when the destination is built.

file_name.description: The name of the current file (default telemetry.jsonl); no path separator.

minimum_severity.description: The lowest severity that is written: TRACE, DEBUG, INFO (the default), WARN, ERROR or CRITICAL.

max_file_bytes.description: The file rotates when the next line would pass this size (default 10485760, 10 MiB). A line larger than this is still written, to an empty file.

max_files.description: How many files are kept, the current one included (default 5). With 1 the rotation removes the file and starts again.

quota_bytes.description: The most that all the files together may use (default 52428800, 50 MiB). Not below max_file_bytes.
